economic_question: Can an immutable global equity high-watermark regime that releases current exposure and persistently scales later births until true recovery retain explosive accelerator profit inside 20% native equity DD?

new_mechanism.name: persistent immutable-global-high drawdown regime
new_mechanism.trigger_state: candidate stressed sampled-equity drawdown from the immutable global high-watermark
new_mechanism.entry_action: realize the released current-book fraction of aggregate marked floating P/L, retain the declared fraction and subtract $25
new_mechanism.persistent_birth_control: every later original birth enters at the declared multiplier and pays $0.10 while risk-off

counterfactual.release_economics: per regime entry, realize the released fraction of aggregate marked floating P/L and subtract $25
counterfactual.released_future_close: retain only the declared fraction of each affected lifecycle's frozen actual/stressed close economics while preserving full observed doubled-cost drag
counterfactual.scaled_birth_economics: multiply frozen actual/stressed lifecycle economics by the risk-off multiplier and subtract $0.10
counterfactual.release_transition_equity_envelope: through the last released original close, apply min(-$25, release final candidate-minus-baseline delta); afterward settle the exact delta
counterfactual.scaled_birth_transition_equity_envelope: from birth through original close, apply min(-$0.10, final candidate-minus-baseline delta, forfeited positive observed peak mark less $0.10); afterward settle the exact delta
counterfactual.identity_check: all settled and active final modification deltas must exactly reconcile modified closed-path economics to the untouched accelerator
counterfactual.interpretation: a conservative fixed-path global-regime proxy, not candidate-specific MT5 proof

selection_gates.profit: after embedded $25 regime-entry reserves, $0.10 scaled-birth reserves and an additional $100 uncertainty reserve, actual and doubled-cost-stressed net must each strictly exceed qualified observed +$1,691.54 / +$1,626.26
selection_gates.epochs: all four modified actual and stressed epoch nets must be positive
selection_gates.capital: actual/stressed closed balances and sampled equity envelopes must remain positive
selection_gates.drawdown: max(qualified native 19.550371765% + 0.25 points, worse conservative sampled equity DD + 0.193561860 points + 0.50 points) <= 20%
